summary: Tou-loca has no registered loader. Port its whole Tourist quest locate program and the source-required selection OR and subtraction functions, preserving selection values and shop-excluding trap placement.

dependencies: Required pure nhlsel.c:l_selection_or (306–330) and l_selection_sub (361–386) are now assigned to this task as the complete source owner for the selection-algebra-values contract. Preserve signed-char encoded integer values, source bounds, and operation order; leave AND/XOR and other selection operators outside this scope.

Existing selection_area/filter_mapchar/rndcoord, region/levregion/door/object/trap/monster owners and deferred stock_room/fill_zoo filling provide the remaining APIs. The Tou-loca temple does not use alignment conversion, and this program does not use the spinach descriptor.

Read all of dat/Tou-loca.lua lines 1–153 (SHA-256 595f7f6265dd3346624aa6de81e7093b05705e67f8c73ed39e75b54caf213d82). It defines solid stone, mazelevel/hardfloor, the 76×20 map, full-map lit/nondiggable regions, eight filled special regions (morgue, two shops, three barracks, zoo, temple), 24 ordinary regions, two local lighting selections, stairs at (10,4)/(73,5), 35 literal doors, 14 random objects and two blank-paper objects at (71,12). Preserve definition order; no explicit wallify call exists.

Tou-loca.lua lines 130–134 filters selection.area(0,0,75,19) to floor, subtracts the union of shop rectangles (15,3–20,5) and (62,3–71,4), then selects and removes nine trap coordinates. Preserve one coordinate frame throughout, with no added RNG draws. The random trap type remains owned by create_trap.

C nhlsel.c l_selection_or (306–330) and l_selection_sub (361–386) are pure: each checks its two selections, creates a fresh result, uses rect_bounds, loops x-major then y-major, stores integer point results with selection_setpoint and returns the new selection. OR uses bitwise | and assigns the union bounds; subtraction uses (a_pt ^ b_pt) & a_pt and recalculates bounds. The registered Lua callers are metatable __bor and __add for OR and __sub for subtraction (nhlsel.c 1005–1018).

C selvar.c selection_new initializes a COLNO×ROWNO map with byte 1; selection_getpoint decodes stored char minus 1; selection_setpoint stores (char)(value+1). The JS selection storage must retain the resulting signed numeric values for these operators while existing boolean get/set and selection users retain their behavior. Pin storage encoding, OR, subtraction, bounds, disjoint/empty inputs, and coordinate-frame preservation from those source functions.

sp_lev.c lspo_region creates special rooms with deferred fill; ordinary rectangles only light regions. At finalization, fill_special_room fills shops, morgue, barracks and zoo; temple only sets has_temple. Preserve region order and existing deferred behavior. No lspo_altar or alignment conversion is called by this temple.

Tou-loca.lua lines 136–153 creates 16 giant spiders and two class-s monsters after traps. Existing named/class monster and blank-paper object owners cover these descriptors; no other shared task contract was identified.

The coordinator approved C176 as complete owner of l_selection_or, l_selection_sub and contract:selection-algebra-values. This claim leaves B200/B202 session reservations untouched and excludes unrelated selection operators. Investigation did not edit game code or record/replay a session.
